# pbt

> pbt is a property-based testing library for Go with the feature set of Erlang's PropEr: generators whose distribution you control, statistics that check it, stateful and parallel command testing, state machines, targeted search and existential properties. Module path go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt; Apache License 2.0; Go 1.25 or later.

This file indexes the documentation of pbt v0.5.2. Every page of the user guide has a Markdown version at its URL with .md appended, and llms-full.txt holds the whole guide in one file. The package documentation on pkg.go.dev is the reference for every function and option; the repository holds the design notes, the migration guide for rapid users, the changelog and the examples. Stateful tests are written as commands that close over a model and a system kept in the test's variables, with no type parameters; generators are typed, and the type is inferred in nearly every call.

## Testing a project with pbt

A coding agent asked to find bugs in a project with pbt works in these steps. Each step links to its section of [Testing a project with an agent](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md), which explains it.

1. [Establish the contract](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#establish-the-contract). Read the project's documentation, public types, tests and fixtures, and the standards it follows. Pick the few places where a bug would hurt most, and write down for each the input domain, the expected result and the sentence that requires it. Do not invent requirements.
2. [Choose an oracle](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#choose-an-oracle). From the cheapest up: no panic (NoPanic, or a call inside Check), a round trip, a reference model checked by Commands and postconditions, invariants after every step, a metamorphic check, a differential check against another implementation.
3. [Build valid inputs](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#build-inputs-that-exercise-the-contract). Construct valid values instead of filtering: Bind for dependent fields, Frequency for the mix, the format package for standard text, Make or pbtgen for Go types, command sequences for state. Check the distribution with Classify, Cover and CheckCoverage, and read the health warnings.
4. [Run in stages](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#run-in-stages). Run the default 100 checks, then more with -pbt.checks, several -pbt.seed values and -pbt.budget. Collect several causes with -pbt.failures and t.Signature. Read results from -pbt.json instead of the console text; -pbt.observe writes OpenPBTStats records for Tyche; -pbt.coverage under go test -cover helps with chains of comparisons.
5. [Investigate a failure](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#investigate-a-failure). Keep the case saved under testdata/pbt and run the report's reproduce line, or -pbt.replay=FILE. For a stateful failure, Causality(n) points at the command after which the failure became likely. Triage it as a real bug, a test bug, intended behaviour or the environment.
6. [Extend a passing test](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#extend-a-passing-test). A pass covers only the generated cases and the assertions that ran. Look for missing shapes in the statistics and in go test -coverprofile, add an independent oracle, count what Assume and Filter remove, raise -pbt.maxsize, then move to another part of the project.
7. [Preserve the evidence](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md#preserve-the-evidence). Never weaken or delete a property, or delete a saved case, to make a run pass, and change the code under test only after a failing test shows the defect. A bug report carries the versions, the minimal input, the commands, the expected and the actual result, and the sentence of the documentation that requires the expected one.

## User guide

- [Getting started](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/index.md): What a property is, how to install pbt, a first property with ForAll and Check, and what happens when it fails: shrinking, the saved case and the replay.
- [Generators](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/01-generators.md): The built-in generators, including times, network addresses, Unicode classes and regular expressions, writing your own with Custom, composing them with Map, Bind, Filter, OneOf and Frequency, reading the draws in a report, and sampling outside a property.
- [Size, distribution and statistics](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/02-distribution.md): The size parameter, weights with Frequency, Sized and Resize, the statistics Collect, Classify, Aggregate, Measure and Cover, CheckCoverage, which turns coverage into a check, and the health checks that warn about wasted or oversized input.
- [Shrinking](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/03-shrinking.md): How a failing case shrinks, writing generators that shrink well, steering the search with ShrinkTo and IntRangeToward, LetShrink and NoShrink, watching a shrink with SampleShrink, why the kind of failure stays the same, naming causes with Signature, and what a failure that does not recur means.
- [Properties and runs](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/04-properties.md): Options and flags, discards, setup and cleanup, property combinators, several failures with MaxFailures and Signature, seeds and stale replay, search time budgets, JSON run reports and OpenPBTStats observations for Tyche.
- [Stateful testing](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/05-stateful.md): Commands as closures over a model and a system kept in the test's variables, Vars for results that do not exist yet, Commands and RunSequential, reading a stateful failure, locating an earlier cause with Causality, and writing good models.
- [Parallel testing](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/06-parallel.md): ParallelCommands and RunParallel, what the interleaving check proves and what it does not, and combining it with the race detector.
- [State machines](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/07-fsm.md): The fsm package: named states, weighted transitions, state data in the test's variables, and statistics by transition.
- [Targeted search and existence](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/08-targeted.md): Maximize and Minimize to steer a run toward utilities, searching for slow inputs through measured work or duration, experimental CoverageGuided search under go test -cover, and CheckExists for witnesses.
- [Generators from types](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/09-types.md): Make and its struct tags, the time and network types it knows, WithType and WithField, generators for recursive types and the bound on their size, and pbtgen, which writes generators as source.
- [Standard formats](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/10-formats.md): The package format: strings in the formats that RFCs, ISO and other standards define, the naming rule that tells the whole grammar from the common form, Go's layout constants, and finding where a parser departs from its standard.
- [Where to go next](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/11-reference.md): The examples that port the PropEr Testing book, the practical examples, the examples of the book on discovering properties, the migration guide for rapid users, the reference material and the flags for search, diagnostics and machine-readable output at a glance.
- [Testing a project with an agent](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/12-agents.md): A workflow for coding agents: derive properties from the project's contract, choose oracles and generators, inspect distributions, run longer searches, replay and triage failures, and report bugs with evidence.

## Reference

- [Package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt): every function and option of package pbt, with runnable examples
- [Package fsm](https://pkg.go.dev/go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/fsm): state machines with named states and weighted transitions
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/main/README.md): what pbt is, a first property and a stateful property
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/main/CHANGELOG.md): the changes of each release and how to upgrade
- [MIGRATION](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/main/MIGRATION.md): rapid's API mapped onto pbt, table by table
- [DESIGN](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/main/DESIGN.md): the design decisions, the API listing and the comparison with PropEr, QuickCheck, Hypothesis, rapid, Hegel and ephyra
- [Examples](https://github.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/tree/main/examples): the PropEr Testing book ported to Go, and practical stateful tests of an HTTP API, a job queue, a rate limiter, a session store and a ledger
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ymotongpoo/pbt/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents that work on the repository itself

## 利用ガイド（日本語）

プロジェクトをテストするコーディングエージェントは、[エージェントでプロジェクトをテストする](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/12-agents.md)の手順に従ってください。

- [はじめに](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/index.md): プロパティとは何か、pbtのインストール、ForAllとCheckによる最初のプロパティ、そして失敗したときに起きる縮小、ケースの保存、再生。
- [生成器](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/01-generators.md): 時刻、ネットワークアドレス、Unicodeの文字クラス、正規表現を含む組み込みの生成器、Customによる自作、Map、Bind、Filter、OneOf、Frequencyによる合成、報告に載る引き値の読み方、プロパティの外での標本抽出。
- [サイズ、分布、統計](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/02-distribution.md): サイズパラメーター、Frequencyによる重み、SizedとResize、統計のCollect、Classify、Aggregate、Measure、Cover、被覆を検査にするCheckCoverage、そして無駄な入力や大きすぎる入力を警告するヘルスチェック。
- [縮小](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/03-shrinking.md): 失敗したケースが縮小される仕組み、よく縮む生成器の書き方、ShrinkToとIntRangeTowardによる誘導、LetShrinkとNoShrink、SampleShrinkによる縮小の観察、失敗の種類が保たれる理由、Signatureによる原因の命名、再現しない失敗が意味すること。
- [プロパティと実行](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/04-properties.md): 実行のオプションとフラグ、Assumeと破棄、SetupとCleanup、Conjunction、Deadline、OnFail、Recover、NoPanic、MaxFailuresとSignatureによる1回の実行での複数の失敗、シードと保存されたケースの再生と陳腐化、探索の時間予算、JSONの実行報告とTycheが読むOpenPBTStatsの観測記録。
- [ステートフルテスト](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/05-stateful.md): テストの変数に置いたモデルとシステムを参照するクロージャとしてのコマンド、まだ存在しない結果を表すVar、CommandsとRunSequential、ステートフルな失敗の読み方、Causalityによる手前の原因の特定、良いモデルの書き方。
- [並行テスト](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/06-parallel.md): ParallelCommandsとRunParallel、交互配置の検査が証明することとしないこと、レースディテクターとの併用。
- [状態機械](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/07-fsm.md): fsmパッケージ。名前付きの状態、重み付きの遷移、テストの変数に置く状態データ、遷移ごとの統計。
- [標的型探索と存在性](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/08-targeted.md): 効用に向けて実行を導くMaximizeとMinimize、測った仕事量や時間による遅い入力の探索、go test -coverでの実験的なCoverageGuided探索、証拠が存在するかを問うプロパティのためのCheckExists。
- [型から導く生成器](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/09-types.md): Makeと構造体タグ、Makeが扱える時刻とネットワークの型、WithTypeとWithField、再帰的な型の生成器とその大きさの上限、生成器をソースとして書き出すpbtgen。
- [規格が定める形式](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/10-formats.md): RFCやISOなどの規格が定める形式の文字列を生成するパッケージformat、文法全体と一般的な形を名前で区別する規則、Goのレイアウト定数、パーサーが規格から外れる箇所の見つけ方。
- [次に読むもの](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/11-reference.md): PropEr Testingの書籍を移植した例題、実践的な例題、プロパティの発見を扱う本の例題、rapid利用者向けの移行ガイド、参照資料、探索と診断と機械可読の出力のフラグの一覧。
- [エージェントでプロジェクトをテストする](https://go.ymotongpoo.com/pbt/guide/ja/12-agents.md): コーディングエージェント向けの作業手順。プロジェクトの契約からプロパティを導き、オラクルと生成器を選び、分布を調べ、長い探索を走らせ、失敗を再実行して切り分け、証拠を添えてバグを報告する。
